name: codex-ppt-dual-render-mvp
description: Local-first Codex MVP for dual HTML and editable PPTX rendering.

scripts.test: node test/mineru-adapter.test.mjs && node test/theme-catalog.test.mjs && node test/narrative-plan.test.mjs && node test/react-renderer.test.mjs
